checks.proves: Partner/Captain custody and exception paths map to Product Truth states.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove transaction ordering/reassignment races.
checks.passCriteria: No UI-local custody/exception truth or pickup bypass path exists.
checks.failCriteria: Missing custody owner, local-only exception or financial side effect is found.

checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove device readback persistence.

checks.proves: Object/Store/Captain scope enforcement is explicitly reviewed.
checks.doesNotProve: Static inspection does not prove runtime isolation.
checks.passCriteria: Every custody mutation proves authorized actor/assignment/Store/order scope and fails closed.
checks.failCriteria: Role-only authorization, cross-Store disclosure or unguarded mutation is found.

checks.proves: Partner/Captain/client/operator custody readback and exception recovery are exercised.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove production concurrency volume.
checks.passCriteria: No pickup before bilateral completion and exception/reassignment readback remains canonical.
checks.failCriteria: Any custody ordering, supersede, exception or readback assertion fails.
